fields.description: Issue of Miami Life published Saturday, December 29, 1934 (Vol. 9, No. 15). Includes an editorial on the brutal murder of bookmaker George "Skeets" Downs and criticism of newspaper portrayals of bookmaking; commentary on gambling and stock-market speculation. Contains local columns and social notes ("They Tell Me," "Things I'd Like to Know"), extensive advertisements and entertainment listings for Miami and Miami Beach (New Year's Eve events, clubs, bars, restaurants), horse-racing coverage and tips related to Tropical Park and daily doubles, and civic/labor items including a Young Democratic Club of Dade County resolution criticizing racing interests for not hiring promised percentages of local workers. Also includes NRA-related notices and discussion of Florida municipal finance including a proposed state sales tax and other public policy items.
